caption: The image shows a rectangular piece of red cloth, possibly a textile sample, placed against a plain off-white background. The cloth fragment has frayed edges and uneven borders, with small areas of discoloration or damage along the perimeter. On the red fabric, there are six small, separate black and brown painted or printed figures, arranged in two uneven horizontal rows. Each figure depicts a human form dressed in light-colored shorts and holding a long object resembling a rifle, with some standing alone and others near shadowy shapes that might represent animals or terrain. Some indistinct dark shapes, possibly birds, are also visible above the figures. There is some faint handwriting in red ink at the lower right corner of the image outside the textile, partially cut off and difficult to read.
title: Textile - Piece of Old Quilted Cloth
